title: Practice in court.
bodyText: Unless specifically provided to the contrary in this chapter or unless inconsistent with its provisions, the Hawai`i probate rules govern formal and informal proceedings under this chapter.
bodyHtml: §560:1-304  Practice in court.  Unless specifically provided to the contrary in this chapter or unless inconsistent with its provisions, the Hawai`i probate rules govern formal and informal proceedings under this chapter. [L 1996, c 288, pt of §1]
